data.name: Benu
data.gender_notes: Benu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Benu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Benu’, meaning ‘born of a lotus’. It is the name of the celestial goose that holds the sacred scripture, Vedas, in its heart. This name is believed to bestow upon the child a pure and pious soul, just like the lotus flower. The name Benu carries the meaning “Made of lotus” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Benu usually hope their child will grow to embody made of lotus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Benu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Made of lotus.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Benu total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
